crossRefs.note: He said, “Bring me a new jar, and put salt in it.” Then they brought it to him.
But he said, “Then bring meal.” He threw it into the pot; and he said, “Serve it to the people, that they may eat.” And…
Now Isaiah had said, “Let them take a cake of figs, and lay it for a poultice on the boil, and he shall recover.”

parallels.note: Now Isaiah had said, “Let them take a cake of figs, and lay it for a poultice on the boil, and he shall recover.”

people.name: Isaiah
people.line: Prophet during reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah.

translations.web: Isaiah said, “Take a cake of figs.” They took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.
translations.bsb: Then Isaiah said, “Prepare a poultice of figs.” So they brought it and applied it to the boil, and Hezekiah recovered.
translations.kjv: And Isaiah said, Take a lump of figs. And they took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.
translations.asv: And Isaiah said, Take a cake of figs. And they took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.
